::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 2d 1890  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Girton College Cambridge, Yonge IV 20
:::

Dear [Mr Innes](people/person_744.qmd),
I have disposed of [Mr Hutchinson’](people/person_740.qmd)s Stars except for this one [chapter](other_books/otherbook_637.qmd). I found when I wrote to him that he had not meant to contribute a regular course but miscellaneous papers now and then. I want however to get the [Engineering recollections in America](other_books/otherbook_632.qmd) into this volume. They are 7 but short, very entertaining and one may be doubled. The story is short too. I have not got [Miss Sewell](people/person_1606.qmd) yet, but I hope to get all in, including [Mrs Hallett](people/person_608.qmd).[^1] The chapter of [Christian’s Name](other_books/otherbook_595.qmd) is very short. I will see about [Miss Watson](people/person_2096.qmd) and her [German](other_books/otherbook_635.qmd) in time. I was going to write to you about Mr Fowler’s [magpie](other_books/otherbook_636.qmd) but it appeared in your parcel yesterday also this note for you from [Mr Church](people/person_2097.qmd)- and a letter which I am sending him to ask if there is any biography of [General Church](people/person_2098.qmd) - it is odd that he and the [Dean of St Pauls](people/person_297.qmd) were discouraged from publishing one, because it was not thought likely to take.[^1]  For General Church was a remarkable man who took a great part in the War of Greek Independence.

I am guarding against being overwhelmed this quarter, but here are 3 or 4 papers about a trip to Italy by Mme [Linda Villari](people/person_1444.qmd) - just come, with a postcard to answer her upon. I had [some from her before](other_books/otherbook_638.qmd), which were liked and she is a good name but continuous papers on Travels are to be avoided I think.  I shall defer the answer as to acceptance till [Miss Coleridge](people/person_329.qmd)comes

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: The letter mainly relates to the disposition of contributions to the issue of *[MP](organizations/other_52.qmd)* for August 1890 and later months. [Elizabeth Missing Sewell](people/person_1606.qmd) published 'Thoughts on Scripture Texts' in the September and October 1890 issues of *MP*.  Mrs Hallett was a regular contributor, but she did not publish anything before 'Country Society of Yesterday' *MP* (December 1891) 637-644.

**Note:** The Rev. Canon Charles Marcus Church (d.1915) was co-editor of the 1895 biography of his uncle,  General Sir Richard Church (1784-1873), liberator of Greece.  The Dean of St.Paul’s, the Very Rev. Richard William Church (1815-1890) was brother to Canon Church.
